execution_policy.after_native_runtime: publish a profile handoff; the runtime owner must perform exact full-token measurement
execution_policy.before_native_runtime: only packed-artifact I/O/header profile may execute; it is never model TPS
execution_policy.no_superficial_rerun: same evidence fingerprint and component artifact never execute twice; a material seal/artifact change is required
execution_policy.run_only_if: sealed candidate record + regular bounded artifact + source-bound artifact SHA-256

cheapest_discriminating_test.distinguishes: ongoing physical pack/admission work from an unsupported claim that a runtime can start today
cheapest_discriminating_test.does_not_claim: a complete model, generation, HCLI, or TPS
cheapest_discriminating_test.test: continue the detached packer to its next sealed material cursor and verify the existing bounded component artifact envelope

conditions.FAIL: reader/component evidence is invalid, or the native decoder cannot execute the bound artifact; seal the narrow failure and do not report TPS
conditions.PASS: a sealed exact full-token receipt proves all native layers/tensors, no fallback, and a complete model token loop
conditions.REOPEN_LATER: the artifact admission seal, runtime implementation, or source-bound kernel implementation materially changes

mechanisms.physical_cause: not every source-bound tensor/control record is present in the complete artifact ledger
the complete catalog may not yet pass strict native artifact admission
even a completed pack still needs architecture-specific decoder/state graph wiring

prior_initialization.architecture_specific_rule: do not transfer Qwen30 attention assumptions directly to Qwen80 DeltaNet

complete_artifact.claim_boundary: complete artifact evidence is separate from native runtime and capability

reasoning.what_currently_prevents_next_gate: the complete artifact/admission prerequisite is not yet sealed, and a native full-token runtime must remain blocked

current_capability_frontier.claim_boundary: no component candidate becomes capable without the sealed capability receipt

current_complete_champion.claim_boundary: complete artifact evidence is separate from native runtime and capability

direct_packed_generation.claim_boundary: observed direct packed execution is not a sealed capability, HCLI, clean TPS, TG, or tournament result

peer_complete_champion.claim_boundary: complete artifact evidence is separate from native runtime and capability

worker_liveness.claim_boundary: heartbeat-only refreshes are explicitly not treated as physical frontier movement
